source.title: Call for Applicants - WRC Leader (October 2022)
source.content:
There will be an appointment of a new WCA Regulations Leader, as Iván Brigidano Pérez’s term is ending as the Leader of the WCA Regulations Committee. We would like to thank Iván for the work he has done leading the committee.

Candidates are expected to fulfill their terms (24 months) and to spend at least 5 hours per week on average to work for the committee. The qualities expected of candidates are:

* Strong leadership skills
* Attention to detail
* Expert knowledge of Regulations
* Analytical thinking
* Excellent communication skills

The application period for candidates to submit their candidacy documents is from **now until October 23rd, 2022, 23:59 UTC**. Interested candidates can send the application privately to the WCA Board ([board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)).
<!-- break -->
**The candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**

* Brief personal introduction.
* Summary of activities done for the WCA.
* Ambitions as the WRC Leader of the WCA.

Candidates are additionally asked to send a copy of their applications which can be made public at the end of the application period.

The rights and duties of the WRC can be found in [WCA Motion 10.2021.9](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.9 - Regulations Committee.pdf).

After the application period, the WCA Board will make a selection by voting and will announce the new Leader, after confirmation among Senior Delegates and sitting Committee/Team Leaders by voting, as described in Section 4 of [WCA Motion 10.2022.0](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf).

Thank you for your candidacies and support.

translation.title: WCA 规则委员会招募负责人（2022 年 10 月）
translation.content:
Iván Brigidano Pérez 的 WCA 规则委员会（WRC）负责人任期即将结束，委员会将任命新负责人。感谢 Iván 在带领委员会期间所做的工作。

申请者应能完成 24 个月的任期，并平均每周投入至少 5 小时参与委员会工作。我们希望申请者具备：

* 较强的领导能力。
* 细心的工作态度。
* 深入掌握规则。
* 分析思考能力。
* 出色的沟通能力。

申请材料提交时间为**即日起至 2022 年 10 月 23 日 23:59 UTC**。有意申请者可私下将材料发送至 WCA 董事会（[board@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:board@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包含：**

* 简短的自我介绍。
* 为 WCA 所做工作的概述。
* 担任 WRC 负责人的工作设想。

此外，请提供一份可在申请截止后公开的申请材料副本。

WRC 的权利与职责见 [WCA 动议 10.2021.9](<https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2021.9 - Regulations Committee.pdf>)。

申请截止后，WCA 董事会将投票选定人选，并依据 [WCA 动议 10.2022.0](<https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2022.0 - Committees and Teams.pdf>) 第 4 节，由高级代表及现任委员会、团队负责人投票确认后，公布新负责人。

感谢大家的申请和支持。
